paper_claim_summary: SIREN provides an executable extreme-weather environment and experience-grounded agent variants covering hazard analysis, prediction, impacts and warning decisions.
primary_contribution: SIREN provides an executable extreme-weather environment and experience-grounded agent variants covering hazard analysis, prediction, impacts and warning decisions.

task_axis_notes: Primary-source task contracts; labels beyond the four main families remain values of the same task coordinate.
classification_notes: Benchmark measures operational questions/actions in an executable environment; do not state all available TS evaluations are static QA. Numerical model training within SIREN-Modeling is not LLM fine-tuning. Extreme-weather case retrieval is TSK: reuse across hazard subtasks does not establish a task-independent temporal-memory mechanism.
